mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 5.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that boost corporate hiring and profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 5.5%, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong aggregate demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both exceed 50th percentile, SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) versus baseline, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production below 105.0 signals weakening manufacturing output, increasing recession risks and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, when INDPRO < 105.0, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL annual inflation rate above 2.0% signals accelerating price pressures, prompting monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.0%, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive 3-month change in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust job growth that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS 3-month change is positive, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,000 thousand units signals weakening residential demand, reducing construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1000.0, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A negative 3-month change in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO 3-month change is negative, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.
